name: Vedant Poly Fabs
summary: Vedant Poly Fabs makes flexible packaging (multi-layer LD films, shrink and barrier films, printed laminates, milk and oil pouches) for food, beverage and consumer goods companies from a single plant at Barasat, West Bengal. Total income rose from ₹49.7 cr in FY24 to ₹115.3 cr in FY26 and profit grew 140% in FY26 to ₹11.0 cr, but operating cash flow was negative in all three years (−₹11.5 cr in FY26) and borrowings rose from ₹6.4 cr to ₹46.8 cr. Related-party transactions were 27.6% of FY26 revenue and the top 10 customers gave 69.4% of sales. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 17.3x, close to the 17.8x median of the listed peers, while price to book of about 2.0x is above the peer median.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Total income rose from ₹49.73 cr (FY24) to ₹115.31 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 52.3%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Total income grew every year: ₹49.73 cr, ₹81.58 cr, ₹115.31 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 1.11 in FY26 (borrowings ₹46.82 cr vs net worth ₹42.26 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 637% (₹6.35 cr to ₹46.82 cr) while total income rose about 132% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹3.86 cr, ₹15.42 cr, ₹42.26 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Cash flow from operations was negative at −₹11.46 cr in FY26 (−₹5.74 cr in FY25, −₹3.46 cr in FY24).

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 140.5% in FY26, from ₹4.56 cr to ₹10.97 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from about 1.3% (FY24) to 5.6% (FY25) and 9.5% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 25.95% in FY26 (ROE 38.03%).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 46.34% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 17.3x (₹189.4 cr market cap on ₹10.97 cr FY26 profit) vs a peer median of 17.8x (B&A Packaging 14.1x, RFBL Flexi Pack 17.8x, Barflex Polyfilms 26.4x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.0x (₹189.4 cr vs ₹93.3 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of about 1.3x, derived from the peers' P/E, EPS and NAV.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Pre-IPO debt conversions, a bonus issue and promoter transfers are reported, but their dates and prices were not found.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 70.08% after the issue, down from 100%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Related-party transactions were ₹31.81 cr in FY26, or 27.63% of revenue (40.72% in FY25).

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The offer for sale is ₹5.67 cr (6,03,600 shares), about 10% of the ₹56.68 cr issue.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The ₹56.68 cr issue is about 29.9% of the ₹189.4 cr post-issue market cap (2,01,51,614 shares at ₹94).

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: The selling promoter Sethsawaria Poly Fab LLP's average acquisition cost was not found.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: Only ₹6.51 cr (about 12.8% of the ₹51.01 cr fresh issue) goes to plant and machinery; ₹17.59 cr goes to working capital.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹8.00 cr, about 15.7% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes was not found in public sources.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were a ₹1.40 cr bank guarantee at March 2026, about 3.3% of net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top 10 customers gave 69.44% of FY26 sales (top 5: 53.64%).

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: The top 5 suppliers gave 79.32% of FY26 purchases, but the largest single supplier's share was not found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated in December 2018, so under 8 years of operating history.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: The statutory auditor had no qualifications requiring adjustment in the restated financial statements.
